old_notes: NO FITTING VALUE RATHER THAN SILENCE. The 掟書 does demand property on default — a 質 and 日状 — but only to the value of the arrear (百五十文), which is security for the agreed contribution, not pursuit beyond it. What the member is actually exposed to beyond his contributions is NON-MONETARY: loss of every 合力 the village extends, and an alienation restraint that runs while he is in (たのもしの衆中のくつろきなく候てハ、くだんうるへからす候 — the thing may not be sold without the 衆中's leave). LS3's locator is monetary pursuit and cannot hold either. Recorded, not forced.
